source_full_text: It began to get colder, and Niels began to walk about a little to keep himself warm. He soon found that they were not far from the edge of the forest, And when he climbed up one of the trees there he could see out over the open country beyond. At a little distance he saw a fire, and beside it there sat three giants, Busy with broth and beef.

reference_text: 天气开始变冷，尼尔斯便开始走动几步，以保持温暖。他很快发现他们离森林边缘并不远，当他爬上其中一棵树时，便能望见森林外的开阔原野。在不远处，他看见一堆火，火边坐着三个巨人，正忙着煮肉汤和切牛肉。
